# Provenance: multi-tool, IDEX and H2C fixtures (PRF-4)

- Source: hand-written JSON for this module. Per-extruder numbers were read from upstream data and re-keyed by slot (facts only, nothing copied wholesale). Research: `docs/research/profiles.md` lines 73-75 (Prusa 3.0 `printer_config`), 183 (Bambu variant arrays), 223 (keyed per-extruder values), 311 (positional arrays).
- Licence of the studied sources: PrusaSlicer and OrcaSlicer AGPL-3.0. The fixtures themselves are our own work.
- `prusa-xl-2t*.json`, `feeder-prusa-xl-toolchanger.json`: the 3.0 shape is `PrusaSlicer@30ef591:resources/presets/prusa-research-fff/PrusaResearch/vendor.yaml:812-818` (`kind: printer_config`, `id: xl-2t`, `tool_count: 2`). Numbers come from the 2.9 INI `[printer:Original Prusa XL - 2T 0.4 nozzle]` (`PrusaSlicer-2.9@b028299:resources/profiles/PrusaResearch.ini:40263-40275`): `nozzle_diameter = 0.4,0.4`, `extruder_offset = 0x0,0x0`, `retract_length = 0.8,0.8`.
- `orca-xplorer-idex.json`: `OrcaSlicer@09aa0114:resources/profiles/Vivedino/machine/Xplorer IDEX 0.6 nozzle.json`: `extruder_colour` (line 19), `extruder_variant_list` (31), `nozzle_diameter` (163), `retraction_length` (222); `is_imex`, `imex_mode_names`, `retract_length_toolchange` ditto.
- `bambu-h2c.json`: `OrcaSlicer@09aa0114:resources/profiles/BBL/machine/Bambu Lab H2C 0.4 nozzle.json`: `nozzle_diameter` (8), `extruder_variant_list` (50), `nozzle_volume` (274), `printer_extruder_id` (287), `printer_extruder_variant` (294), `retraction_length` (336), `hotend_heating_rate`. Keys `0`..`4` are the five (extruder, variant) rows of the native arrays, in native order; `printer_extruder_id` and `printer_extruder_variant` map a row to its extruder and variant. Native strings of numbers were converted to numbers. Bed size is from `printable_area`; `max_height` and kinematics are illustrative.
- `negative-positional-array.json`: the XL 2T model with `nozzle_diameter` as a positional array; must be rejected (see the test).
- Created 2026-10-26.
